note: Function declarations for the campus route planner. The shape is the OpenAPI subset Gemini, Claude and OpenAI all accept; adapt the wrapper key per provider.

functionDeclarations.name: plan_route
functionDeclarations.description: Plan a walking route across the JHU Homewood campus. Returns real geometry from A* over the campus path network, with distance, time and a step breakdown. Always call this rather than describing a route from memory; never write or adjust coordinates yourself.

origin.description: Where the trip starts, as a building or outdoor space name, e.g. 'Malone Hall'. Free text is resolved against the place index.

destination.description: Where the trip ends, e.g. 'San Martin Garage'.

profile.description: walk_smart is the default for someone on foot: it may cut across lawns and finish at any door or lift. walk is the same without lawn shortcuts. step_free blocks stairs and hazard-graded segments. accessible also prefers fully compliant surface at 8x weight, buying better surface for extra distance. Use step_free or accessible whenever the user mentions a wheelchair, a mobility limit, a pushchair, crutches or wheeled luggage. walk_smart is NOT wheelchair-safe: its shortcuts cross grass with no surface or kerb data.

functionDeclarations.name: compare_routes
functionDeclarations.description: Plan the same trip under several profiles at once, to answer questions like how much longer a step-free route is.

functionDeclarations.name: list_places
functionDeclarations.description: Every routable place name on campus, with its use and any alias. Call this when a name the user gave does not resolve, or when plan_route returns status 'ambiguous'.
